items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: source rights remain unproven; security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. The compliance baseline is technical evidence only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown, with banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy evidence is partial and does not support closure. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, expand alerts, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted caching, display, retention, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Compliance, data quality, analytics, and revenue support containment-only execution. Preserve cookie and analytics disclosures, consent and withdrawal behavior, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright and trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where supported by site evidence. Do not treat failed telemetry as zero. Revenue is limited to the dated 2026-09-21 record: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable; ROI, margin, payback, and causal lift remain unknown. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and a completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization.
